messages:
sam: Quick follow-up on the on-prem upgrade RFC. Proposal: bandwidth-first path using chunked sparse-pull + chunk-index to avoid full bundle transfers. Short reactions?
leah: +1. Need a compact index shape so mirrors can cheaply answer availability queries.
diego: Chunk-check API idea: GET /index/latest, POST /chunks/check with ids -> returns booleans + sizes. Mirrors send only missing chunks.
rachel: For activation, use overlay FS + atomic root swap. Keep important runtime chunks staged first. Watch IO and inode pressure.
sam: GC: manifest carries persistent_chunks and gc_horizon to prevent premature deletion. Mirrors GC only unreferenced chunks older than gc_horizon.
leah: Operator policies: BANDWIDTH_PRIORITIZE (sparse pull), ATOMIC_SWAP, STREAMING_ACTIVATE. Default BANDWIDTH_PRIORITIZE on slow links.
diego: Fallback: if >X% critical chunks missing after probe window -> fallback to ATOMIC_SWAP if available, else abort and alert. Probe default 45s.
infra-bot: bench-job: sparse-pull vs atomic-swap scheduled 2026-04-12 02:00 UTC.
rachel: Test plan: simulate 10Mbps link, 2GB model delta, measure bytes transferred and activation time. Add chaos for dropped chunk-check responses.
sam: I'll update the RFC with index example, APIs, overlay steps, GC pin/unpin, and runbook knobs. Assign follow-ups: @leah index schema, @diego PoC endpoints, @rachel runbook. Closing thread.
